pages.text: ASSIGN stores the value of an expression in a variable. The value must fit the type of the variable. An INTEGER may go into a FLOAT, and a CHAR into a STRING.
$(1)ASSIGN arithmetic 1 + 2 * ( 3 + 3 ) \ 10 * 2 + 10 ;$(br)ASSIGN list[0] 10 ;$(br)ASSIGN list[1] 20 ;$(br)ASSIGN list[2] list[0] + list[1] ;$()
Assigning to the index right after the end of a list adds a new element. A new key adds a new element to a hash.
